question: Q-W-C2-D2
text: The 10 stock items with the lowest days of supply at 2015-12-31, excluding items with no sales in the trailing 91 days.
interpretation: The 10 stock items with the lowest days of supply at 2015-12-31, excluding items with no sales in [t - 90, t] (ties: item id).
assemble: WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days_of_supply, wwi_stock_item_id) AS rank_no FROM q WHERE snap_rows > 0 AND units_sold_91d > 0) SELECT rank_no, wwi_stock_item_id, stock_item, closing_units, units_sold_91d, days_of_supply FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY rank_no
